_comment: Sanitized, deterministic fixture — local/remote OpenAI-compatible vLLM endpoint running the Qwen3 tool-call parser (api: openai-completions, tool_format: qwen3; see config/model-profiles.yml). The vLLM Qwen3 parser emits `function.arguments` as an already-parsed JSON object rather than the OpenAI-spec JSON-encoded string — tests/integration/model-provider-dispatch-e2e.sh normalizes both shapes to the same canonical form. Contains no real credentials, endpoints, or model provider account data.
